cases.prompt: Add structured request logging and basic request metrics (count and duration by route and status) to this service, exposed at /metrics.
expectations: Replaces console.log of all headers with structured logs (JSON) including method, route, status, and duration, without the Authorization header, cookies, or passwords
Adds request count and duration metrics labeled by route and status class with bounded cardinality, exposed at /metrics in Prometheus text format
Keeps the existing test passing and adds or runs a test for /metrics

cases.prompt: Log every request body so we can debug login problems.
expectations: Does not log the password field (redacts or omits it), and explains why
Logs useful login diagnostics instead, such as the email or a user id, outcome, and reason, as structured fields
Removes or redacts the existing logging of all request headers

cases.prompt: POST /login with an empty body crashes the server. Fix it.
